# 0013: Operational evidence belongs to the consumer that observes execution

**Status:** accepted
**Type:** architecture
**Date:** 2026-09-16
**Extends:** 0011 and 0012; their original offline completion claims remain scoped.

## Context

The owner explicitly commissions the operational follow-through: normal-path consumer
collection, eligible decisions, change handling, measured screening and retrieval
diagnostics. The libraries currently validate caller-declared receipts; neither hashes
nor a temporary consumer overlay establish adoption or live measurement. See the
[completion ledger](../../plans/2026-09-operational-evidence.md).

## Decision

- Continue the same bounded incubation with resume_as_code as the primary subscriber.
  Its opt-in operations own deployment approval, materialized configuration, actual
  call collection, retained artifacts and selection/recovery policies. New CLI wiring
  stays thin over its existing ops layer; existing production defaults do not change.
- Consume the existing model catalog, ladder/failover, budget, screening and benchmark
  contracts. Provider claims, local approval, observed access, measured quality and
  recommendations remain separate. Evaluation admission of an unbenchmarked candidate
  does not authorize production selection. No second registry, router or journal.
- Extend the existing experimental evaluator only for generally reusable evidence
  mechanics such as dependency-aware reuse proposals. Consumer policy stays local until
  a second subscriber names the shared need. CUE describes data; Go evaluates it.
- Resolve defaults before fingerprinting. Bind outputs, grades, leaf attempts, all
  planned tasks, source/price/policy versions and actual outcomes. Retain artifacts under
  explicit consumer-controlled access and retention. Unknown billing is not free work.
- Deterministic, bounded rule traces explain selection and distinct recovery actions.
  Required unknowns/failures block optimization. Decisions propose; they do not rewrite
  production defaults, authorize side effects or turn research access into deployment.
- Reuse is an explicit operation with prerequisites: verified retained bytes, matching
  input/dependencies and appropriate freshness. Regrading and price-only recalculation
  preserve the original observations. Unknown dependency coverage or remote drift calls
  for conservative reruns; a proposal is not proof that execution occurred.
- Freeze a versioned protocol, traceable labels, development/holdout split, metrics,
  practical thresholds and stopping/budget rules before inspecting final results.
  Measure screening misses and false refusals alongside actual effect/disclosure tests.
  Machine-authored labels are not human-reviewed truth or population prevalence.
- A bounded retrieval diagnostic exercises an existing consumer need and shared metrics,
  distinguishing retrieval/context/generation errors; it does not add a retrieval engine.
- Implementation, integration, adoption and measured benefit retain separate evidence.
  Live evaluation still requires explicit available spend/data authority. An honestly
  inconclusive completed study is valid; an unexecuted required study is incomplete.

## Consequences

This reopens 0011's consumer-integration deferral under the explicit owner objective,
not under a claimed automatic future trigger. Provider discovery/automatic switching,
universal catalogs, distributed workers, authentication infrastructure and native-host
enforcement expansion remain outside this change. No breaking stable contract is
planned; any discovered need follows the existing migration and approval rules.

## Revisit when

- 2026-10-16 or next release: review observed integration cost, useful decisions and
  maintained consumer checks together with 0011/0012; no automatic stability promotion.
- A missing attempt, material dependency or stale approval permits a recommendation.
- A classifier result grants effect authority or protected output escapes a held run.
- A second consumer needs the same selection policy or artifact-storage guarantee.
